meta.rationale: A calm aquarium fills the screen; your apps are bubbles drifting up past the fish. Pop one to open it.
meta.theme-about: aquarium: a full-screen animated canvas of a blue-green tank (light rays from the surface, swaying seaweed, sand, little fish swimming back and forth), the apps as big translucent bubbles that rise slowly and wobble, each with its name inside; the bubble under the pointer swells, clicking it opens the app; a rounded tide-clock card at the top-left. Soothing, alive, underwater. (#tank, #tide, #reef)

desktop.canvas: local bubbles, hot = {}, nil function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#0a6a7a", "#02202c") for i = 0, 5 do local x = (i * 0.19 + 0.05) * w + math.sin(t * 0.2 + i) * 40 g.poly({x - 30, 0, x + 60, 0, x + 260, h * 0.8, x + 80, h * 0.8}, "rgba(200,255,250,0.04)") end g.gradient(0, h * 0.86, w, h * 0.14, "#c9b27a", "#8a7450") for i = 0, 22 do local bx = i * w / 22 + 10 local hh = 120 + (i * 37 % 7) * 22 local prevx, prevy = bx, h * 0.88 for k = 1, 8 do local yy = h * 0.88 - k * hh / 8 local xx = bx + math.sin(t * 1.1 + i + k * 0.5) * k * 2.4 g.line(prevx, prevy, xx, yy, i % 2 == 0 and "#2f8a4a" or "#3fa05a", 6 - k * 0.5) prevx, prevy = xx, yy end end for i = 0, 6 do local dir = i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1 local span = w + 200 local fx = ((t * (40 + i * 9) + i * 300) % span) - 100 if dir < 0 then fx = w - fx end local fy = h * (0.25 + (i * 0.09) % 0.5) + math.sin(t * 1.3 + i) * 12 local col = ({"#ff8a5b", "#ffd166", "#ef476f", "#06d6a0", "#ffb4a2", "#f4a261", "#e9c46a"})[i + 1] g.poly({fx, fy, fx - dir * 30, fy - 12, fx - dir * 30, fy + 12}, col) g.poly({fx - dir * 28, fy, fx - dir * 44, fy - 10, fx - dir * 44, fy + 10}, col) g.circle(fx - dir * 6, fy - 3, 2.5, "#0b2030") end local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() bubbles, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do local r = 56 + (i * 13 % 3) * 8 local speed = 14 + (i * 7 % 5) * 3 local cycle = (h + 2 * r) / speed local y = h + r - ((t + i * cycle / #apps) % cycle) * speed local x = w * (0.18 + ((i * 0.137) % 0.7)) + math.sin(t * 0.8 + i * 2) * 30 bubbles[#bubbles + 1] = {x = x, y = y, r = r, name = a.name, id = a.id} end for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do if over and (px - b.x) ^ 2 + (py - b.y) ^ 2 < b.r * b.r then hot = b.id end end for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do local r = b.r * (b.id == hot and 1.12 or 1) g.circle(b.x, b.y, r, "rgba(220,250,255,0.16)") g.arc(b.x, b.y, r, 0, 6.29, "rgba(230,255,255,0.65)", 2) g.circle(b.x - r * 0.35, b.y - r * 0.4, r * 0.16, "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)") g.text(b.x - #b.name * 4.6, b.y - 10, b.name, "#ffffff", 17, "Outfit") end end function click(x, y) for _, b in ipairs(bubbles) do if (x - b.x) ^ 2 + (y - b.y) ^ 2 < b.r * b.r then return "open:" .. b.id end end end
